title: Spicy {p} with {v}
steps: Cut the {p} into cubes and simmer in gently boiling salted water for 2 minutes. Drain carefully.
Cook the {v} with the {spice} in a hot oiled pan until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Stir in the {sauce} for a minute, then add a cup of broth and bring to a boil.
Slide in the {p} and simmer 3 to 4 minutes, until the sauce coats it. Serve over the {s}.
tip: Tofu and mushrooms make this filling with very little fat. Go easy on the salty sauce.
